description: Apply available OS package updates (all, or security-only) on a node, optionally reboot when required, then refresh the pcm_patch posture. The console reads the resulting posture via the pcm_patch fact on the next run.

console_url.description: Console base URL (server-injected; unused by the patch itself).

ingest_token.description: Server-injected; unused by the patch itself.

security_only.description: Apply only security updates when true; otherwise apply all available updates.

reboot.description: Reboot the node afterward if a reboot is required.
